ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Figure 9 is a schematic diagram of the distribution of a coastal city in southeastern China. <image1> What is the main factor causing the equal-rent lines in some local areas in the figure to protrude outward from the city center?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the diagonal-line shading represents the central urban area, located in the middle-south part of the city distribution map, on the near-sea side. The dashed lines represent equal-rent lines, which as a whole are distributed in concentric zones around the central urban area, but in local directions are not regular, instead protruding outward from the city center. The legend shows that the thick black line is a railway, and the solid lines are roads; the railway runs roughly north-south through the central urban area, and the roads also extend outward from the central urban area. Then reason: comparing the direction in which the equal-rent lines protrude outward with the directions of the railway and roads, it can be seen that the protruding parts are basically consistent with the extension directions of the traffic lines. Traffic lines improve the accessibility and location conditions of the areas along the lines, making the land rent along traffic lines at the same distance from the city center relatively higher, so the equal-rent lines protrude outward along the traffic corridors. Therefore the main factor is transportation.

raw_record.question_text:
Figure 9 is a schematic diagram of the distribution of a coastal city in southeastern China. <image1>
What is the main factor causing the equal-rent lines in some local areas in the figure to protrude outward from the city center?

method.method_draft: 先描述图像：确认中心城区位置、等地租线形态以及公路和铁路的走向；再将局部等地租线向外凸出的方向与交通线叠合比较；若凸出部位沿铁路、公路等交通廊道分布，则判定主要原因是交通运输改善了沿线区位条件和可达性，导致地租相对升高并向外延伸。答案写“交通运输”。
method.CoT_raw: 先描述图像：图中斜线阴影表示中心城区，位于城市分布图的中部偏南、近海一侧。虚线表示等地租线，整体围绕中心城区呈圈层状分布，但在局部方向并不规则，而是由市中心向外凸出。图例显示粗黑线为铁路，实线为公路；铁路大致南北向穿过中心城区，公路也从中心城区向外延伸。再推理：把等地租线外凸的方向与铁路、公路走向比较，可以看出外凸部位与交通线路延伸方向基本一致。交通线路改善了沿线地区的可达性和区位条件，使同距市中心的交通沿线地租相对较高，所以等地租线沿交通廊道向外凸出。因此主要因素是交通运输。

method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中左下侧为海域，中心有斜线标注的中心城区；中心城区周围分布着虚线表示的等地租线。图中有多条公路从中心向外延伸，粗黑线表示的铁路大致南北向穿过中心城区，河流也在中心附近通过。等地租线并非规则同心圆，而是在若干交通干线延伸方向上由市中心向外呈局部凸出。推理：这种外凸不能单纯用距市中心远近解释；若主要由海岸或河流影响，外凸应更明显沿海岸或河流展开。图中异常地租升高主要出现在公路、铁路等交通干线通达的方向，说明交通可达性提高使沿线地租偏高。因此主要因素是交通运输。
